text: The LDLC / LDLC.com brand is run by Groupe LDLC, a French société anonyme à directoire et conseil de surveillance with a share capital of €1,110,919.68, registered in Lyon (RCS 403 554 181, Limonest).
short: LDLC.com is run by Groupe LDLC, a French listed company (RCS Lyon 403 554 181).
